timing: Pure personal turns, distinct active Pure global turns
basic: Additional resolved GGS Dragon within two following Pure turns AND net increase in simultaneous GGS Dragons or >=5 offensive power, or >=2 hand/Treasure resources without losing offensive power, against immediate Dragon-1 state
strong: 2+ resolved GGS Dragon creations in one Pure turn
extra combat plus net >=5 offensive power growth and GGS Dragon creation
2+ observed engine-drawn cards plus 2+ Treasure creations with continued GGS production and >=2 cards left
threatening: 20 actual unblocked attacking combat power after legal blocks, after ignition
15 actual Pure combat damage to opponents in one Pure turn after ignition
20 actual total Pure damage to opponents in one Pure turn after ignition, including amplifier damage
dependency: Natural requires no material amplifier in path to threshold. Amplified requires actual contributing amplifier effect; amplifier-dependent requires direct contribution necessary to cross threshold at observed time. Uncertain causal cases stay unclassified instead of guessing. Counterfactual attribution is observational, not a randomized ablation.
stabilization: At least 64 valid games and 40 ignited games; latest two increments differ <=10 percentage points for conversion/basic/strong/threatening and natural/dependent; timing medians <=1 Pure turn difference; leading stall reason unchanged. Report Wilson intervals. Continue if unstable, bounded at 128 with explicit inconclusive qualification if needed.
clarification: Before analyzing experimental batch 1, tightened board threat evidence to actual unblocked attackers rather than assuming flying bodies will connect.
analysis_clarifications: Track other comparable amplifiers (including stolen Annie Joins Up).
Purphoros damage alone does not count as material to Basic/Strong board growth.
Include noncombat amplifier damage in Table-Threatening State evidence, rather than missing burn-driven threats.
Causal necessity remains observational and uncertain cases are explicitly retained.
Damage thresholds follow exact canonical phase/combat/life state, not future damage from later extra combats.
Throne type decisions are standalone audit events and must be read even without state.
Post-ignition stalls consider disruptions in the first two-turn progression window, not earlier pre-ignition removal.
Traced mass spell/ability losses of >=3 creatures count for wipe recovery; untraced combat casualties are excluded.
Report Natural states both without material amplifier contribution and with no amplifier present before the threshold.
Basic resource growth requires observed engine draw/Treasure growth, so two ordinary draw steps alone cannot qualify.
Additional combats count as material only after observed additional-combat production/resources/damage; scheduled but unused combats do not count.
Additional-combat board growth is measured from the first-combat end state, not before the ordinary first combat.
Casual mulligan counts are read from each seat's actual engine opening-hand log.
Reliable access confirmed means GGS fresh-connection triggers observed on two distinct Pure turns, separate from access-card availability.
